examples.trans: We're going to start filming you, okay?

黒木香のデビュー作だ
本作のモザイクは当委員会の規定より―

examples.text: とにかく早く急いで用意してくれえっ？
とりあえず座って一緒にごはん食べよう
examples.trans: Well, come and eat with us first.

examples.text: いやおっさんと川田が前線で戦ってるんすよ
examples.trans: Muranishi and Kawada are doing everything they can.

meanings.note: Satisfied exclamation when gearing up or finishing a task cleanly.
